canon_ref.note: Day 39. Six die in the ambush; Cervial's team loses four in all. Hunt of the Horns is paralysed by a Wight. Gregor and Menes are not NPCs.

b1.expedition_breaks_the_crypt_ambush.summary: The dead burst from hidden alcoves, led by four Crypt Lords; six adventurers die. Ceria lights the halls with [Illumination], and Olesm's [Rapid Retreat] gets nine mages clear. Then Calruz, his voice swollen by a spell, dares the dead to come; with Olesm's [Attack Formation] the teams destroy them.

system.name: Spell [Illumination]
system.note: Lights every place she has walked; she also casts [Fireball] and [Flashfire]. Her wand holds [Ice Spike].

system.name: [Attack Formation]
system.note: Once a day at his level; the whole force fights lighter and stronger.

system.name: [Hammer Blow]
system.note: Used without a word to split a Crypt Lord: 'Not every Skill or spell must be shouted.'
